summary.text: Jesse Borjon is a Republican state representative from Topeka who has represented Kansas House District 52 since 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A business owner, he chairs the Legislative Modernization Committee.

paragraphs.text: Borjon was born and lives in Topeka, Kansas, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Washburn University.
His career experience includes owning and operating a property management company and a local retail store.
He has volunteered with Topeka South Rotary, United Way's Young Leaders Society, and the Friends of the Topeka Zoo Board of Directors.
Borjon took office in the Kansas House on January 11, 2021, succeeding Representative Brenda Dietrich.

During the 2025-2026 session he served on the Commerce, Labor and Economic Development, House Judiciary, Energy, Utilities, and Telecommunications, and Information Technology committees, and chaired the Legislative Modernization Committee.
